Happy to. One thing first: next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) is almost fully booked. The only free gaps inside working hours are:

How long should the staff meeting be, and which slot do you prefer? I've asked Sarah which of these work for her.

Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov). His week is nearly full, so the only free gaps are: Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Which of these work for you, and how long do you need? I'll confirm the slot once he picks one.
Thirty minutes is enough — let's take Tuesday 11:00-11:30. If that doesn't suit Sarah, Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is my second choice, and if she can only do Monday, Mon 14:00-14:30 is my third.
Noted: Tue 11:00-11:30, then Wed 13:00-13:30, then Mon 14:00-14:30. I'll book as soon as Sarah confirms — she hasn't answered yet.

Hi, thanks for coordinating. I checked my week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) against what you sent:

- **Mon 10:00-10:30** — no, I'm in my CSE452 lab focus block (09:50-11:00).
- **Mon 14:00-14:30** — no, study group 13:10-14:10 then seminar from 14:10.
- **Tue 11:00-11:30** — no, seminar until 11:10, then lunch; the block is split.
- **Tue 15:00-15:30** — technically free, but it ends the moment my CSE455 office hours start at 15:30, so it would be tight. Only as a last resort.
- **Wed 10:00-10:30** — free ✓ (office hours start right after, at 10:30).
- **Wed 13:00-13:30** — free ✓ (quiz section at 13:30 after).

So my first choice is **Wed 10:00-10:30**, second **Wed 13:00-13:30**. 30 minutes is enough for me. Tell me which one he picks and I'll put it in my calendar and confirm back to you.

Booked: **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**. Professor Alvarez's order of preference was Tue 11:00-11:30, then Wed 13:00-13:30, then Mon 14:00-14:30; since Tuesday didn't work for you, he gets his second choice. I've put it in the calendar and logged it. Please add it to yours and confirm back.

**Wed 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**

It's in the calendar and logged (BOOKED: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 with Sarah). I've told Sarah and asked her to confirm from her side.
